responsibility: This file defines the detailed DFA scheduling model for the I6400 core, including both scalar MIPS and MSA/vector execution. It models integer control, address-generation, multiply/divide, floating-point short and long pipelines, and extensive reservation classes for scalar ALU/load/store/branch/FP operations as well as MSA integer, floating-point, division, copy, branch, and control-register instructions, making it the central scheduler description for r6-era i6400 tuning.
